method: Mac race controls left untouched; phone supplied race inputs. Aggregate gap/RTT include both devices. Prior retained mobile solo data may contribute frame statistics.

notes: Application JSON and declared completed HTTP body bytes; excludes TLS/WS/HTTP headers, aborted partial bodies and provider accounting.
